title: 第十三章 黑鼎新功能第十四章 借风化龙
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
一直盯着许天的人，自然是狗蛋。
自从上次被刘二狠狠羞辱后，他看似消停，实则贼心不死。
回想近日种种遭遇，李狗蛋总觉有人在背后推波助澜。
太巧了。
都TM太巧了！
那只绣花鞋，以及与三丫闹掰等等。
所有事情，都有一个病秧子的身影。
许天！
“装，你一定是在装！”
咬着牙，李狗蛋心中愈发笃定。
凭什么其他杂役都在挨饿受冻，只有这个废物每次都能在关键节骨眼上拿出清毒散？
一定有猫腻！
“头儿！”
李狗蛋突然站起身，一瘸一拐走到刘二身边，低眉顺眼说了几句。
这段日子，他夹着尾巴做人，成功让两个护卫对他再次放松警惕。
瞥了他一眼，刘二眼神一动，随即无所谓地摆摆手。
得到许可，李狗蛋抄起一把生锈铁铲，悄无声息朝后山摸去。
.....
后山，乱葬岗。
正值晌午，这里却阴风阵阵。

将那具刚背来尸体扔进坑里，许天没有急着埋土。
站在坑边，他背对来路，露出一抹异样表情。
凭他炼气期的神识，身后的李狗蛋，就像黑夜里的灯笼一样显眼。
但许天并未打草惊蛇，而是默默挖起土。
他料定李狗蛋没有耐心。
果然。
片刻后。
“嘿嘿......许天，你是真没发现老子，还是装的。”
随着枯枝被踩断脆响，李狗蛋提着一把生锈铁铲，从阴影里走出来。
铁锹一顿，许天脸上佯装吃惊。
李狗蛋却闪烁凶光，不给他出声机会：
“许天，别装了，老子就知道你身上肯定有秘密！”
“那晚的绣鞋，还有刘二打老子......都是你搞的鬼吧？”
闻言，许天无奈道：
“狗哥，你在说什么？我......咳咳，不是很清楚......”
“少TM给老子装！”
李狗蛋根本不吃这一套，手中铁铲寒光闪烁，步步紧逼：
content_en:
The person who has been staring at Xu Tian is naturally a bitch.
After being severely humiliated by Liu Er last time, he seemed to have calmed down, but in fact his evil intentions were still there.
Looking back on all the recent experiences, Li Goudan always felt that someone was behind the scenes.
What a coincidence.
What a coincidence!
That embroidered shoe, and breaking up with Sanya, etc.
In everything, there is a sick figure.
Xu Tian!
"Faking, you must be faking!"
Gritting his teeth, Li Goudan became more and more confident.
Why is it that while other handymen are starving and freezing, only this loser can come up with Qingdu Powder at critical moments every time?
There must be something fishy!
"Boss!"
Li Goudan suddenly stood up, limped to Liu Er's side, lowered his eyebrows and said a few words.
During these days, he kept his tail between his legs and successfully made the two guards relax their vigilance towards him again.
Glancing at him, Liu Er's eyes moved, and then he waved his hands indifferently.
After receiving permission, Li Goudan picked up a rusty shovel and quietly moved towards the back hill.
.....
Back hill, mass grave.
It was noon, but the wind was blowing here.
Throwing the newly carried body into the pit, Xu Tian was not in a hurry to bury it.
Standing by the pit, he turned his back to the way he came from, showing a strange expression.
With his spiritual consciousness in the Qi refining period, Li Goudan behind him was as conspicuous as a lantern in the dark night.
But Xu Tian did not alert the snake, but quietly dug up the soil.
He expected that Li Goudan would not be patient.
really.
After a while.
"Hehe...Xu Tian, are you really not aware of me, or are you just pretending."
With the crisp sound of dead branches being stepped on, Li Goudan walked out of the shadows carrying a rusty shovel.
The shovel paused, Xu Tian pretended to be surprised on his face.
However, Li Goudan flashed a fierce light and did not give him a chance to speak out:
"Xu Tian, stop pretending, I know there must be a secret in you!"
"The embroidered shoes that night, and Liu Er's beating on me... were all your fault, right?"
Hearing this, Xu Tian said helplessly:
"Brother Dog, what are you talking about? I...ahem, I'm not very clear..."
"Young man, pretend to be me!"
Li Goudan did not accept this trick at all. The shovel in his hand flashed with cold light and pressed forward step by step:
